proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s A B C D hA hB hC hD hAB hCD hpar
  have hdir := hpar.direction_eq
  have hmem : D -ᵥ C ∈ (line[ℝ, A, B]).direction := by
    rw [hdir]
    exact AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ C D) (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ C D)
  rw [direction_affineSpan, mem_vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hmem
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_smul] at hk
    exact hCD (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp hk.symm).symm
  have hN : ∀ {X : P}, X ∈ s → ‖X -ᵥ s.center‖ ^ 2 = s.radius ^ 2 := by
    intro X hX
    rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V, EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mp hX]
  set a := A -ᵥ s.center with ha
  set c := C -ᵥ s.center with hc
  set u := B -ᵥ A with hu
  have hb : B -ᵥ s.center = a + u := by rw [ha, hu, add_comm, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
  have hd : D -ᵥ s.center = c + k • u := by rw [hc, hk, add_comm, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
  have e1 := hN hB
  have e2 := hN hD
  rw [hb, norm_add_sq_real, hN hA] at e1
  rw [hd, norm_add_sq_real, inner_smul_right, norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, ← hN hC] at e2
  have e3 : 2 * inner ℝ c u + k * ‖u‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have : k * (2 * inner ℝ c u + k * ‖u‖ ^ 2) = 0 := by linear_combination e2
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hk0
  have hAC : A -ᵥ C = a - c := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ _ _).symm
  have hBD : B -ᵥ D = (a - c) + (1 - k) • u := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right B D s.center, hb, hd]
    module
  rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V A C, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B D, hAC, hBD]
  refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp ?_
  rw [norm_add_sq_real, inner_smul_right, norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, inner_sub_left]
  linear_combination (-(1 - k)) * e1 + (1 - k) * e3
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B C D : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → C ∈ s → D ∈ s → A ≠ B → C ≠ D → (line[ℝ, A, B]).Parallel line[ℝ, C, D] → dist A C = dist B D
